text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...I'm gradually starting to understand.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I first set that goal,
it was still hazy and vague, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"A victory surpassing all previous Kikuka Sho Umamusume"—
its outline was gradually coming into view.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: In short, it's about a vividness that defies common sense, a "running" that inspires hope for the future.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So shocking that it even surpassed that Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
This is ridiculously difficult...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But if I could create a work like that...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for springing this on you,
but could I ask a favor... please?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...For me?
From Kita-chan?

Toward the end of summer camp.
Upon Kitasan Black's request, we decided
to organize a joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to bother you,
having you accompany me during such a busy time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No, no, the pleasure's all mine!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, this is an important time for you, right?
You're going to challenge the 'Autumn Senior Triple Crown' next...!"

The Fall Senior Triple Crown consists of the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen.
Capturing all three in a single year is an extraordinarily difficult feat—
choice_data_list: ...Only two people in history have ever achieved that, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's why I want to give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely.
Kiseki-san, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to run for real.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeyaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —!? This is Kita-chan giving it her all...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're running because you want to get everyone excited, right, Kiseki-san!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Me too! I feel the exact same way!
I just want to make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black finishes in 9th!
She was unable to live up to her 1st-favorite status!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Making that come true
is extremely difficult……!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, will you refuse to give up?
Can you keep facing forward toward the crowd?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with wanting to win?
What's wrong with craving the thrill of victory?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, do not seek victory alone.
Do not drown in its sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Enduring Challengers
text_block_list.text: Surpass it! Toward an even more thrilling "race"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I know.
But I can do it. I'll prove it to you!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please stay with me!
Kiseki-san!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Kgh... She's fast...!
I can't catch up to Kita-chan at all...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Or ratherâ!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (The footing is getting unstable...! It's so dense with foliage, there are even puddles...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(If I'm going to run, a cleaner line...
The course Kita-chan is picking right now is optimal.
In that case, I'll stay right here————)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm going to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"To surpass both the Triple Crown Umamusume and every past Kikuka Sho Umamusume...
to create *my* 'Kikuka Sho.'"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Find a way forward! Scour every corner!
Carve out a path no one else would dare take!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's where my—challenge lies!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Charge forward! Take the shortest line!
Even if—the footing is pure mud!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! I'm completely covered in mud...!
I keep slipping and sliding, it's so hard to run...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(With my wide-strided running style,
this side path really is too tight...!!
Even so...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-san!
I'm a "Kikka-sho Umamusume" too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Ghh—! Guwaaaaaah! Forget about stability! Stride out bigger and run! I'll tear through the ground as I sprint!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...... Ahahaha!!
That was brutal! Giving it full power right down to the toesâ

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—A 2000m middle-distance race is one thing,
but the 3000m Kikuka Sho is a battle of pure endurance.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this race is all about how well
you can maintain your stamina. So...
running yourself into exhaustion is out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They say the weapon of a certain Kikuka Sho Umamusume
was a powerful step that came down with a heavy thud.
Her charm was an acceleration that tapped into every last ounce of stamina.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I could combine that style of running—pushing your stamina
to the absolute limit—with my own wide stride..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――"Normally," anyone would collapse. Absolutely.
There's no way you could run 3,000 meters like this.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, I "want to do it."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's fun!
It gets your heart racing!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Surpass common sense!
Create expectations for the future with these legs!
Make it more entertaining than anyone else!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Kiseki-saaan!
Can you stand up?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Wait, huh... me...!?
choice_data_list: Good, you've recovered quite a bit.
Good, you've recovered quite a bit.

text_block_list.text:
Right after racing against Kitasan Black,
without even time to cool down,
Kiseki suddenly staggered and fell unconscious.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh, I see...!
You've completely run out of energy already...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—But don't worry anymore!
Trainer, it's finished!
My latest creation!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Achieving both a powerful run that grips the ground
and maximizing stride length at the same time!!"
Hoping to get a doctor's advice just to be safe, we moved near the training camp lodge... but Kiseki's explanation still showed no signs of stopping.
choice_data_list: I see, so there are downsides as well.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because it requires focus all the way down to my toes,
until I get used to it, my mind and body will be running on overdrive...
and I might collapse just like I did a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Plus, while it might not quite be a drawback,
...it would be best to lock her running style into "Late-Surge."
choice_data_list: Because it doesn't work well with a "Front Runner" style?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Because once she starts her final spurt,
there's no stopping her acceleration."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, her running will definitely
thrill everyone! It's a run that can take on the world!”
choice_data_list: A run capable of aiming for the world...!

text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, if an Umamusume were to appear and win
the Kikuka Sho—a true test of stamina—with such ideal running,
the crowd would undeniably go wild."
With stamina, power, and speed, you'll definitely be able to hold your own on the world's greatest stage—!
choice_data_list: It's a running style that takes that much more energy and stamina, but...
It's a running style that takes that much more energy and stamina, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
If it's me—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You'll be doing joint training with Kita-chan after this too, so be ready!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Are you sure you're all right!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! If it were really bad, Trainer would have stopped me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: As long as you pass the medical check with no issues!
If everything looks good after the medical check, that is!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You say "if there's no problem,"
but you sound so eager...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —You can do it, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely make sure
to thrill everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Kiseki!
Summer training camp is over already!
We're back at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... Wah-nya...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: They're not waking up at all—!?
choice_data_list: Let them sleep. They worked hard this summer.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Trainer's giving a piggyback ride?
Boo will help out too!
I escort Kiseki, who had completely exhausted all her energy at summer camp, all the way to the dorm entrance.

This summer, Kiseki...
really worked her hardest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Make them excited, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Kiseki-san brings a 'festival' to everyone, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...—Ah, hello?
Dia-chan? Did you arrive in France already?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Yup, our summer training camp just wrapped up too.
And so, you see—...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —There's something I've decided on.
